d: Olive-green hair is styled in a short bob with straight bangs and a small braid on the right side, paired with wide, amber-colored eyes and a youthful, adolescent expression. The build is petite, dressed in a white long-sleeved shirt under a sleeveless burgundy jumper with a large teal bow at the chest and gold straps on the shoulders. Signature details include heavy metallic grey naval weaponry and gun turrets attached to the back and sides.
